title: [sveltejs/svelte] Fix issue #18643: invalid JS from @type JSDoc on export let plus $:
description:
Fix GitHub issue #18643 in sveltejs/svelte:
https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/issues/18643

Issue title: esrap 2.3.3: server codegen emits invalid JS when @type JSDoc on export let meets a $: declaration

Deliverables:
- Submit a real code change in the target repository.
- Open an upstream pull request against sveltejs/svelte that fixes the issue.
- Include focused regression coverage or tests where appropriate.
- Include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in your OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot.
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only; code plus an upstream PR is required.
